summary: Tested Binance Wallet Integration. All 16 backend API tests passed (100%). All 15 frontend UI tests passed. BinanceWalletPage loads correctly with real-time prices from Binance US API, simulated wallet assets, distribution chart, and WebSocket live updates. ChatBot FAQ and ticket creation features verified.

issues: Console warning: recharts PieChart width/height -1 on initial render (cosmetic, chart renders correctly after data loads)
Console warning: HTML hydration - <tr> cannot be child of <span> (caused by React dev tools wrapper, not affecting functionality)

passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/binance/prices - Returns real-time prices for BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, XRP, ADA, DOGE, DOT, AVAX, LINK
✅ GET /api/binance/tickers - Returns 24h change data with price_change_pct, high_24h, low_24h, volume
✅ GET /api/binance/wallet - Returns full wallet with assets, distribution, top_assets (requires auth)
✅ Wallet auto-creates default portfolio with 10 assets on first access
✅ 3 summary cards: Total Value ($189,489.87), Available ($170,708.68), Locked ($18,781.2)
✅ Distribution donut chart renders with 6 visible segments (BTC 49.54%, ETH 19.42%, BNB 15.82%, SOL 5.12%, XRP 3.82%, LINK 2.76%)
✅ Top Assets section shows top 5 coins (Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, Solana, Ripple) with values and % changes
✅ Asset list table shows 10 rows with columns: ACTIVO, PRECIO, 24H, DISPONIBLE, BLOQUEADO, TOTAL, VALOR USD
✅ WebSocket status indicator shows 'En vivo' (green) - connected to wss://stream.binance.us:9443
✅ 'Actualizar' (refresh) button works - triggers wallet data refresh
✅ Sidebar has 'Wallet / Activos' link with Bitcoin icon
✅ Disclaimer text at bottom: 'Precios proporcionados por Binance API... LIONSBIT VERIFICACION no esta habilitada para inversiones reales ni trading'
✅ ChatBot opens with FAQ suggestions (¿Cómo retiro mi dinero?, ¿Por qué debo pagar impuesto?, etc.)
✅ ChatBot has 'Hablar con soporte (crear ticket)' button
✅ ChatBot ticket creation form has Asunto and Mensaje fields

context_for_next_testing_agent: Binance Wallet integration fully tested. Uses api.binance.us for REST API (not api.binance.com which is geo-blocked). WebSocket connects to wss://stream.binance.us:9443 for live price updates. Wallet assets are simulated (stored in MongoDB crypto_wallets_sim collection) but prices are REAL from Binance. AVAX replaced MATIC because MATIC is unavailable on Binance US. Admin can modify wallet balances via POST /api/admin/wallet/assign endpoint.
